title: jacobaea cernua
intro: Jacobaea cernua, commonly known as Nodding Ragwort, is a perennial plant in the daisy family, characterized by its distinctive nodding inflorescence and yellow flowers. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea cernua include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory issues and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential medicinal applications.
